declarations.name: center_sub_radius
declarations.signature_excerpt: @[simp] theorem center_sub_radius (I : OpenInterval) : I.center - I.radius = I.l

declarations.name: center_add_radius
declarations.signature_excerpt: @[simp] theorem center_add_radius (I : OpenInterval) : I.center + I.radius = I.u

declarations.name: ball_center_radius
declarations.signature_excerpt: theorem ball_center_radius (I : OpenInterval) : ball I.center I.radius = I.toSet

declarations.name: mem_toSet_iff
declarations.signature_excerpt: theorem mem_toSet_iff {I : OpenInterval} {x : ℝ} : x ∈ I.toSet ↔ I.l < x ∧ x < I.u

declarations.name: exists_disjoint_interval_subfamily_covering_enlargement
declarations.signature_excerpt: theorem exists_disjoint_interval_subfamily_covering_enlargement (t : Set ι) (I : ι → OpenInterval) (R : ℝ) (hR : ∀ a ∈ t, (I a).radius ≤ R) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 3 < τ) : ∃ u ⊆ t, u.PairwiseDisjoint (fun a => (I a).toSet) ∧ ∀ a ∈ t, ∃ b ∈ u, (I a).toSet ⊆ ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius)

declarations.name: volume_iUnion_le_mul_tsum
declarations.signature_excerpt: theorem volume_iUnion_le_mul_tsum (t : Set ι) (I : ι → OpenInterval) (u : Set ι) (_hut : u ⊆ t) (hdisj : u.PairwiseDisjoint fun a => (I a).toSet) (hcov : ∀ a ∈ t, ∃ b ∈ u, (I a).toSet ⊆ ball (I b).center (τ * (I b).radius)) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) : volume (⋃ a ∈ t, (I a).toSet) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal τ * ∑' b : u, volume ((I b).toSet)

declarations.name: vitaliFamilyVolume
declarations.signature_excerpt: noncomputable def vitaliFamilyVolume : VitaliFamily (volume : Measure ℝ)

declarations.name: measure_le_of_frequently_le_vitali
declarations.signature_excerpt: theorem measure_le_of_frequently_le_vitali {μ : Measure ℝ} (v : VitaliFamily μ) {ρ : Measure ℝ} (ν : Measure ℝ) [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure ν] (hρ : ρ ≪ μ) (s : Set ℝ) (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ᶠ a in v.filterAt x, ρ a ≤ ν a) : ρ s ≤ ν s

declarations.name: fineSubfamilyOn_measure_le_tsum
declarations.signature_excerpt: theorem fineSubfamilyOn_measure_le_tsum {μ : Measure ℝ} {v : VitaliFamily μ} {f : ℝ → Set (Set ℝ)} {s : Set ℝ} (h : v.FineSubfamilyOn f s) : μ s ≤ ∑' x : h.index, μ (h.covering x)
